declarations.description: Enhances the first light-DOM table with native popover controls for column visibility. Configure exact first-header-row names before initialization. The component injects no CSS. Attribute and structural child-list changes rebuild controls; previous hidden cell styles are not restored during cleanup. Disconnecting cancels initialization, disconnects the observer, and removes controls and their listener.
declarations.name: TableModifiableElement

members.name: removable
members.description: Required comma-separated exact first-header-row names. Missing or empty values leave the table unenhanced and emit a warning.

members.name: startWith
members.description: Initially visible removable columns. Missing or empty attributes show all removable columns. Use valid matching names; unknown names can hide all removable columns.

members.name: buttonLabel
members.description: Visible toggle label; missing or empty attributes use Modify Table.

members.name: buttonAriaLabel
members.description: Accessible toggle label; missing or empty values use button-label or its default. Include the visible label in a longer accessible name.

members.name: toolsLabel
members.description: Visible panel label; missing or empty values use Show/Hide Columns.

events.name: table-modifiable:change
events.description: Bubbles after an accepted checkbox visibility change. Initial hiding and rejected last-checkbox changes do not emit this event.

attributes.name: removable
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of all column names that can be shown/hidden

attributes.name: start-with
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of which columns should be visible by default. If not specified, all removable columns will be shown initially

attributes.name: button-label
attributes.description: Text label for the toggle button (default: 'Modify Table')

attributes.name: button-aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible label for the toggle button. Use this to provide a more descriptive label for screen readers if needed (default: same as button-label)

attributes.name: tools-label
attributes.description: Heading text for the popover panel (default: 'Show/Hide Columns')

cssProperties.name: --table-modifiable-tool-bg
cssProperties.description: Author-stylesheet hook used by the demo popover styles. Pair with --table-modifiable-tool-color. The component itself injects no CSS.

cssProperties.name: --table-modifiable-tool-color
cssProperties.description: Author-stylesheet hook used by the demo popover styles. Pair with --table-modifiable-tool-bg. The component itself injects no CSS.

modules.description: Class-only package entry; does not register a custom element.

declarations.name: defineTableModifiable
declarations.description: Importing this module registers the default tag when a browser registry is available. The helper returns false without that registry; otherwise defines the requested tag if absent and returns true. Repeated calls for the same tag are safe.

declarations.name: defineComponentName
declarations.description: Compatibility wrapper for defineTableModifiable with the same arguments and return value.
